DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis

The elevated Acetylcholine Receptor Antibodies, combined with your symptoms of double vision, difficulty climbing stairs, and upper limb weakness that likely worsens with activity, are classic indicators of Myasthenia Gravis. This condition causes muscle weakness due to impaired communication between nerves and muscles. Do you experience significant fatigue after prolonged activities like reading or lifting objects?
